title: Judith E Probable NDE 9605
content: I had been in intensive care following surgery. I felt like I was fading away and dying. I heard a nurse keep saying to me, 'You can't die. You have a husband and son who love you.' I was walking with determination towards a tunnel. The tunnel was dark at the end, rather than light. I thought it was like a birth experience. There was a man in a raincoat who stood with his back to me. After the experience, I thought he might be my guide. Before I could inquire further, I focused on the nurse who kept repeating that I couldn't die. My first thought was my husband and son could look after each other. I turned round and walked back into my body, though I did not want to do so. I didn't tell anyone about my experience at the time. As a young woman, I had a marijuana experience where I saw us all as facets of a huge crystal. When I mentioned this to my psychotherapist, I discovered she had had the same experience. Another experience that I had when a trainee hypnotherapist worked with me was that I was floating, high above my physical body. I felt so free and did not want to return. When he counted down to '1' I was back in my body. Again, I told nobody about this for many years since I had no place to explain these experiences. Background Information: Gender: Female Date NDE Occurred: July 2001 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Yes Surgery-related. Illness, trauma or other condition not considered life threatening. I was trying to recover from acoustic neuroma surgery How do you consider the content of your experience? Both pleasant AND distressing Did you feel separated from your body? Yes. No way of knowing for sure since I told nobody. I lost awareness of my body How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? More consciousness and alertness than normal. A clarity At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? All the time Were your thoughts speeded up? No Did time seem to speed up or slow down? No Were your senses More vivid than usual? More vivid than usual Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. I had been in intensive care and was very confused Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. Sharper Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere? Yes, but the facts have not been checked out Did you pass into or through a tunnel? No Did you see any beings in your experience? No Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? No Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? No Did you see an unearthly light? No Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? No What emotions did you feel during the experience? Determined to leave lufe Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Relief or calmness Did you have a feeling of joy? Happiness Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? I felt no longer in conflict with nature Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? No Did scenes from your past come back to you? No Did scenes from the future come to you? No Did you come to a border or point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will. The was right about my husband and son, so I returned to my body. God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Unaffiliated- Nothing in particular- Religious unaffiliated Have your religious practices changed since your experience? Yes I meditate daily following a huge number of physical health challenges What is your religion now? Unaffiliated- Nothing in particular- Religious unaffiliated. I believe that we are all loving energy Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was entirely not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience. It was only later that I thought about the man as a guide. There were no angels. Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Uncertain No change until I read of the experiences of others. This was validation to me. Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? No Did you see deceased or religious spirits? No Did you encounter or become aware of any beings who previously lived on earth who are described by name in religions (for example: Jesus, Muhammad, Buddha, etc.)? No During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? No During your experience, did you gain information about universal connection or oneness? No During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? No Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? No During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? No During your experience, did you gain information about an afterlife? Uncertain I felt I was at a border Did you gain information about how to live our lives? No During your experience, did you gain information about life's difficulties, challenges and hardships? No During your experience, did you gain information about love? Uncertain. It was love for husband and son that brought me unwillingly back What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? Slight changes in my life. Less fear of death. But how do we really know until death faces us? Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? No After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? Yes I had no way of explaining this in words to anyone How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience. No way of knowing Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? No Are there one or several parts of your experience that are especially meaningful or significant to you? They all seem significant Have you ever shared this experience with others? No Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? No What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was probably real. I don't really know what 'reality' means after my experience. What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was probably real. Experience remains so vivid in my mind At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No Is there anything else that you would like to add about your experience? No

tunnel.movement_other_detail: Walking with determination towards a tunnel.

arrival.other_being_detail: A man in a raincoat stood with his back to her; she later thought he might be her guide.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: She turned around and walked back into her body.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Recovering from acoustic neuroma surgery; in intensive care post-surgery.

stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Out-of-body fading/dying state with awareness of nurse; movement toward a dark-ended tunnel; barrier/point of no return; turned back and returned to body after focusing on husband and son.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Tunnel described as dark at the end rather than light; she interpreted it as like a birth experience. A man in a raincoat stood with his back to her (later considered possibly a guide).
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “You can't die. You have a husband and son who love you.”
